answer: To resist Sybil attacks in an autonomous economy of AI agents, networks can employ a cryptographic stake-weighted trust graph that functions like a structural vine, interconnecting verified nodes. Each legitimate agent must anchor its digital identity to a provable computational resource or scarce economic deposit, preventing infinite self-replication. If a malicious entity attempts to flood the system with synthetic personas, automated telemetry protocols act as a digital raven, instantly detecting anomalous behavioral patterns and slashing the fraudulent collateral.
